title: Great App!
body: Very happy with this app and its presentation. Very well made and very easy to understand with valid pricing. If I was to give one criticism it would be for the presentation of ticked off weekly, monthly and yearly goals in the ‘Habit Reports’ page. If one completes the habit 100% then it would be more motivational for the user to see the whole week blocked off instead of seeing just the day of the completion if the goal. This of course needs further discussion as it might be considered mispresentation to bkock off the whole time period. For example, if you have a yearly habit that is supposed to be completed 4 times a year then it would be nice to see the whole year blocked out once the habit is completed - and then simply doing an outline on the days that they have ticked off the habits. Idk how this would work but either way I love this app. I just felt slightly deflated when completing a monthly goal and then checking the ‘Habit Report’ page only seeing one day out of the month being ticked despite it being quite a big habit that i put high effort in across the month.

title: Really Helped
body: I suffer with low mood/depression and I know that having a structured routine helps lift me out of it - but I always lack motivation to get started/stick to it. HelloHabit really helped me have a way to visually track simple things - I’m talking very simple daily things like “shower” “text a friend” and “walk for 30 mins”. Doing these things consistently helps with my low mood, having something to visually track whether I’ve done them really helps me.

title: Editing notes of frustrating on my phone
body:
Great app, not over complicated, loving the layout, colour coding system, dark mode, reminders. 

Although, I do have one bug to currently when taking notes there is a bit of a bug, every time I go to select a position for my cursor by tapping the screen, the keyboard comes up in front of the text so I can’t see where I am typing! I then try to scroll down to see where I have placed the cursor and what I am typing, maybe having to reposition the cursor where I would like to type. For some reason it decides to remove the cursor and scroll back to the top of the note which means I have to try that whole process of scrolling down and attempting to position the cursor and again. 

This results in the note taking side of the habit tracker being very frustrating to use if you like taking longer notes. 

Would be 5Stars from me if this bug was fixed 👍
